title: A FLARE BEFORE EVERY WAVE
why: His answer 10 a: a spawn telegraph before a wave. A DEMO wave used to appear out of nothing. Now, when a wave is coming, a red drop-in flare goes up where it will land, with a rising charge sound and WAVE INCOMING, and the pack lands at the flare two and a half seconds later. The flare burns above the dark and the fog (a bright core, a pulsing ring on the ground and a beam of light), so you always see where the enemies will come from and can take cover or move. In 2 player DEMO both players see the flare. The size, the kinds and the timing of the waves are unchanged. CAREER raids get the same flare when the waves come to CAREER.
now: Every wave is now announced by a red drop-in flare and WAVE INCOMING where it will land, two and a half seconds before it arrives.
